messages:
maya: Posting follow-ups from the 03/07 outage postmortem — assigning remediation owners and timelines. Please ack and add Jira links.

alex: Ack. I'll own RINF-2479 (kv-cache eviction analysis). ETA EOW. :white_check_mark:

sam: I'll take RINF-2480 (runbook + playbook updates). Need eng-sre notes and rollback steps.

kev: Can we pair on the runbook, sam? I have context on the rollback step and the k8s rollout quirks.

oncall-bot: Incident 2024-03-07: outage resolved. Postmortem draft uploaded -> https://docs.redwood.internal/postmortems/2024-03-07. Reminder: attach remediation tickets.

olivia: Assigning QA validation task -> RINF-2481. I'll be accountable (A). Due 2024-03-21.

maya: RACI for RINF-2479: R=alex, A=maya, C=eng-sre, I=product. Please comment if that looks off.

alex: Noted. I'll create the ticket and add acceptance criteria + perf test plan. Jira will be at https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-2479 once created.

sam: Added a short checklist to the postmortem doc about runbook steps and required dev/build gating: https://docs.redwood.internal/postmortems/2024-03-07 (inline edits).

kev: Handoff note: alex will own the remediation code change, sam will own runbook + rollout test. Let's schedule a 30m sync Thu to align.

maya: @alex @sam please confirm sync time. Also clarify PR owner vs reviewer.

alex: I'll PR the fix, sam will review. PR owner = alex. I'll tag @eng-platform for rollout gating.

maya: Can eng-platform review config toggles for canary/rollout policy? @olivia pls add that to scope (RINF-2482).

olivia: Will add RINF-2482 (platform review) and set me as R. Will include checklist for observability + tracing.

alex: Quick question: do we want to deprecate the old kv-cache path or keep toggles?

maya: Decision for now: keep the old path, add a runtime toggle flag behind config and a one-week canary. Document this decision in the postmortem.

sam: Logging/metrics follow-up: RINF-2483 assigned to kev. I'll consult on required histogram buckets. ETA Mon.

kev: Ack. I'll start a small RFC and drop it in the thread.

maya: Good progress — I'll update the master remediation tracker and create the weekly follow-up checklist. Next sync: Friday 10:00am PT. If any blockers surface before then, DM me or ping here. Thanks all. :pray:
